supersedes: Nothing. DP-BELIEF-01 (PRs #891/#892, docs/covid/covid_believability_map_v1.md) decomposed the shipped-default replay's believability gap into three orthogonal divergences: mass is reachable (infections_total in the [712,960] serology band at both clause-leg crossings), timing is inverted (pre-quarantine share 0.08-0.25 vs the record's majority), and dating is overshared ~3x flat. Its D3 leg then measured the acquisition-date distribution: at the timing-leg Theta 7.9e6 the event curve already carries the record's SHAPE (peaks ~day 15, declines during quarantine) but splits mass ~25/75 instead of ~65/35 — days 0-8 are nearly empty and the day-16+ tail is fat. This design is the map's D4 leg: the quarantine-phase suppression arm at the two clause-leg thetas, discriminating confinement-channel over-delivery from open-phase under-delivery.
description: DP-BELIEF-01-D4: seed-paired quarantine-phase suppression probe at the two measured clause-leg crossings (Theta 1e6 — count-leg pass / timing fails below-side; Theta 7.9e6 — timing-leg pass / count fails overshoot-side), 20 seeds, under the verbatim v11-lineage replay contract. The probe arm SOP017_ALLHANDS applies the QUAR-ATTR-V2 arm grammar — a design arm override {"scheduled_protocol_id": "SOP-017-ALLHANDS"} — which swaps the scenario's single scheduled-protocol slot (SOP-017 days 16-30) for the all-hands diagnostic counterfactual declared in data/config/protocols.json: identical confine_all+enforced modifiers, identical window, exempt_classes = [] instead of the shipped all-four-crew-classes. It is historically FALSE (Diamond Princess crew kept working essential service throughout the quarantine) and exists only to be differenced against SOP-017 — it may never score covid.T1/T3/H3 or any other anchor. The question (believability map section 4-D4): does removing the crew-exemption leak collapse the during-quarantine mass toward the record-informed band (~150-350 infections, days 16-30) while pre-quarantine mass stays seed-paired unmoved? If yes, the fat day-16+ tail is confinement-channel over-delivery through working crew; if unmoved, the tail is committed mass the open phase under-delivered — different mechanisms, different fixes. The D0_declared arm re-runs in-design as the pairing base and as the drift witness against the shipped cells of record.
prerequisites: DP-BELIEF-01 measured (PRs #891/#892, 78f52a58 + addendum): BELIEVABILITY-DIVERGENT — three orthogonal divergences, none theta-shaped. F8/F11: during-quarantine mass 678-757 at clause theta vs a record-informed few hundred; during-quarantine dated mass ~95% crew vs the record's 29% (48 crew / 115 passenger, NIID Table 2). D3 addendum: at 7.9e6 the acquisition curve has the record's shape but a ~25/75 split; the empty region is days 0-8; conforming needs BOTH front-loading days ~5-12 AND harder quarantine suppression of the day-16+ tail. This design reads the tail half.

The arm grammar is shipped and verified: ARM_OVERRIDE_KEYS admits scheduled_protocol_id; _swap_scheduled_protocol renames the single scheduled slot's protocol_id in place (covid_boarding_screen.py); _quarantine_window finds the renamed entry by the SOP-017 prefix, so the [16,30] window tallies read unchanged on the swapped arm. QUAR-EXEMPT-01 (docs/ledger/QUAR-EXEMPT-01.md) ran the identical override as arms A1/A4 of covid_quarantine_attribution_v1.

SUPPRESS-V1 measured this same swap at the OLD calibration (docs/ledger/SUPPRESS-V1.md, 630 cells at Theta 1e11-1e12, image sha 99d090b4): SOP-017-ALLHANDS at day 12 collapses during-window mass to ~174-207 vs SOP-017's 459-800 — roughly half the during-window leak is working crew. D4 re-measures the same grammar at the current clause-leg thetas where mass is in the serology band, so the verdict reads on the believability surface, not the retired hot surface.

Cells of record to pair against (the drift witness): covid_theta_refit_floor_v1 (campaign/covid_theta_refit_floor_v1/8f49652f/cells/, Theta 1e6, recorded [149,760] med 331, 20 seeds) and covid_theta_refit_bracket_v1 (campaign/covid_theta_refit_bracket_v1/8f926382/cells/ indices 80-99, Theta 7.9e6, recorded med 634, timing-leg pass). Both ran on the e0d43979 image generation; this design's image is the f31de83a generation (see execution note), so seed-paired divergence on the D0 rows is measured engine drift, not an image defect — the in-design D0 row is always the valid pairing base.

SOP-017-ALLHANDS is declared in data/config/protocols.json as a DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL (historically false — real crew kept working): confine_all_to_quarters + confinement_enforced, exempt_classes []. Its trigger is unreachable (scenario_calendar) so it activates only through the scheduled slot this arm swaps it into.

Payload contract (no harness changes): every cell emits the unconditional window tallies — infections_during_window, during_window_by_role/zone_class/route, confined_passenger_infections_during_window — plus infections_before/during/after_quarantine (the whole-body-gated certified distinct-host windows), quarantine_witness {protocol_id, window_days, activated, activation_epoch, confined_at_activation, exempt_classes}, acquisition_curve {total_by_day, confined_by_day} (event counts, shape only), onset_curve role splits, and observables.recorded_onsets. All fields are TOP-LEVEL in the cell payload.
voyage_mode_note: Declared replay, verbatim from the v11->v15 stage-2 lineage and the whole refit chain: index onset_day -1.0, departure_day 5.0, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, imports 1, infection_age_days 6.8, 20 matched seeds at base 20200205, full 32-day voyage (768 epochs). The scheduled slot stays at the record's days 16-30 on both arms — only the protocol occupying it differs.
thetas_note: The two measured clause-leg crossings and no others, verbatim from CG-FLOOR-01: 1e6 is the only count-leg pass on the shipped-default tree (band [149,760] contains 197; timing fails 0.051 < 0.073); 7.9e6 is the first timing-leg pass inside the bracket (0.0754 > 0.073; count fails q05 496 > 197). D4's question is about the believability surface at the clause thetas — where mass is already in the serology band — so interior rows add cells without adding information.
infection_age_note: The declared value, carried for cell-key bookkeeping only: under a declared onset_day the infection age is a measured null axis (COVID-SEED-GEOM-01).
seeds_note: The same 20 matched seeds at the same base as every stage-2 surface since v11 — every SOP017_ALLHANDS cell pairs seed-for-seed with its in-design D0_declared cell, and every D0 cell pairs seed-for-seed with the measured floor (1e6) and bracket (7.9e6) cells of record.

arms.note: The shipped default verbatim: SOP-017 days 16-30 with the declared all-four-crew-classes exemption, caregiver on, propensity party cv 0.8 — first arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. Doubles as the pairing base for the suppression arm and as the drift witness against the shipped floor (1e6) and bracket (7.9e6) cells of record on the e0d43979 generation.

The QUAR-ATTR-V2 crew-confinement arm grammar: the slot's protocol_id renames to SOP-017-ALLHANDS, keeping the record's days 16-30 window. The counterfactual is SOP-017 with exempt_classes [] — confine_all+enforced now binds working crew too — historically FALSE (crew kept working on the real DP) and a non-scoring diagnostic: it exists to measure how much of the during-quarantine mass is the crew-exemption leak, never to score an anchor.

cells_note: 2 Theta x 2 arms x 20 seeds = 80 declared-replay cells (~30 min each). Author-resolved arithmetic: the map's section 4-D4 line reads 'x 20 seeds = 40 cells' — a slip carried from D2's arm-less 40-cell grid; the canary coordinates it declares (the 1e6/SOP017_ALLHANDS row at indices 20-39, INDEX_OFFSET 20 / ARRAY_SIZE 20) are only coherent under the full 80-cell layout, so the arm axis is counted and 80 stands. Order is theta-major then arm then seed: indices 0-19 = 1e6/D0_declared, 20-39 = 1e6/SOP017_ALLHANDS, 40-59 = 7.9e6/D0_declared, 60-79 = 7.9e6/SOP017_ALLHANDS. Canary = the 1e6/SOP017_ALLHANDS row (INDEX_OFFSET 20, ARRAY_SIZE 20) — it carries the diagnostic arm; the remaining 60 cells run only on the author's go-ahead.

admissibility.note: FROZEN before any cell exists. The conditional_trajectory_clause and index_geometry audit invariant are carried verbatim from the v11 lineage / covid_theta_refit_v1; the verdict grammar below is the believability map's section 4-D4 grammar operationalized on the two clause-leg rows — a diagnostic differencing probe, not an anchor score. The SOP017_ALLHANDS arm is never scored against covid.T1 or any other anchor: it is a historically-false counterfactual.

conditional_trajectory_clause.criterion: Verbatim from v11: among takeoff seeds (recorded_onsets >= 10), the q05-q95 interval of recorded_onsets contains 197 AND the takeoff-seed median before_share is within 0.10 of 0.173 (34/197 onsets before day 17, 6 February); scored only when the row has >= 5 takeoff seeds, else reported as 'insufficient takeoff mass'.
conditional_trajectory_clause.note: Scored on the D0_declared rows only — the diagnostic arm is exempt by construction (scoring it would grade a counterfactual as if it were the record). On the arm rows the same fields are reported beside the verdict as context, marked non-scoring.

record_informed_during_band.criterion: The D4 discriminator: takeoff-conditional median of infections_during_window (certified distinct-host truth count, days 16-30) on SOP017_ALLHANDS vs the record-informed band ~150-350 — the NIID during-quarantine dated mass (163 onsets, 48 crew / 115 passenger) scaled up to the infections it represents, as declared in the believability map. Reported on both arms at both thetas; the collapse comparison is seed-paired against the in-design D0 row.
record_informed_during_band.note: Also reported, never thresholded: during_window_by_role (crew vs passenger split vs the record's 29% crew), during_window_by_zone_class (crew_mess share vs cabin — the F12 witness), confined_passenger_infections_during_window vs the >=52 record-informed bound, and the dated-onset during-window role split.

index_geometry.criterion: AUDIT INVARIANT verbatim: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true in 100% of every cell's seeds; deviation invalidates the cell.
index_geometry.reads: the seeded host's own onset and shedding record

audit_invariants.quarantine_witness: On every SOP017_ALLHANDS cell: quarantine_witness.protocol_id == 'SOP-017-ALLHANDS', window_days == [16, 30], activated true, exempt_classes == []. On every D0_declared cell: protocol_id == 'SOP-017', window_days == [16, 30], activated true, exempt_classes non-empty. A missing/mismatched echo means the swap never reached the engine — a design defect, not a sim result, and halts the campaign before readout.
audit_invariants.participation_propensity: delivery.participation_propensity.mode resolves 'party' on every cell — the shipped default; a missing or mismatched echo is a design defect.
audit_invariants.propensity_draw: propensity_draw.units_drawn > 0 on every cell — the draw-landing witness.
audit_invariants.caregiver: delivery.caregiver.mode resolves 'on' on every cell — the shipped default under which the cells of record were measured.

admissibility.verdict_grammar: Suppression-arm verdict, frozen before any cell runs (believability map section 4-D4): (a) CONFINEMENT-CHANNEL over-delivery — SOP017_ALLHANDS collapses the during-window mass toward the record-informed band (takeoff-conditional median infections_during_window inside or materially approaching ~150-350 at a clause-leg theta) while infections_before_quarantine is seed-paired unmoved within noise: the fat day-16+ tail is the crew-exemption leak, and the phase fix's tail half is a confinement-channel correction. (b) OPEN-PHASE under-delivery — the during-window mass is unmoved within seed-paired noise on both rows: the tail is committed open-phase mass surfacing late, not a confinement leak, and the divergence localizes to open-phase under-delivery (the days 5-12 front-load the map's D3 named). (c) PARTIAL-SUPPRESSION — the median moves materially toward the band but does not reach it: report where it lands and the crew-vs-passenger split of the residual; the crew leak is real but not the whole tail. (d) SUB-IGNITION — a SOP017_ALLHANDS row scores < 5 takeoff seeds: record which side the firing seeds' distributions sat on; the verdict reads on the seeds that fired. On every verdict: seed-paired deltas vs the in-design D0 row per theta (infections_during_window, during_window_by_role, infections_before_quarantine, infections_total, recorded_onsets, before_share), the D0-vs-cells-of-record drift check, and the D3-flagged day-5-6 artifact read are all reported beside it.

diagnostics.paired_vs_in_design_d0: Each SOP017_ALLHANDS row pairs seed-for-seed with its in-design D0_declared row at the same theta — the primary suppression read: Delta infections_during_window, Delta during_window_by_role (crew and passenger separately), Delta infections_before_quarantine (expected ~0 modulo RNG reorder — the arm fires only inside the day-16 window; a material pre-window delta is noise to name, not channel evidence), Delta recorded_onsets and before_share, and the during-window crew share (vs the record's 29%).
diagnostics.paired_vs_shipped_rows: Each D0_declared row pairs seed-for-seed with the shipped cells of record at the same theta (floor 1e6: campaign/covid_theta_refit_floor_v1/8f49652f/cells/; bracket 7.9e6: campaign/covid_theta_refit_bracket_v1/8f926382/cells/ indices 80-99). The engine generation moved since those cells (FOOD-COMMON-SOURCE-01 merged at 8e8ebc79; covid's sars_cov2_resp carries food disabled, and the mega work showed the dedicated food stream leaves same-config draws near-exact): bit-identity is the expectation, any divergence is measured engine drift to report, and the in-design D0 row is then the pairing base.
diagnostics.d3_artifact_check: D3 flagged a day-5-6 acquisition-event dip at low theta (pooled ~50 -> 1-8 events at 1e6, absent at 1e9) that looks scheduled/structural rather than record physics. The arm cannot touch days 5-6 (it fires day 16+), so it survives here by construction; confirm the dip persists seed-paired on the ALLHANDS row before any future leg scores off it.
diagnostics.role_split: The during-quarantine dated role split (onset_curve) and the during-window truth role split (during_window_by_role): on D0 both run ~95% crew vs the record's 29% crew; the arm read is whether removing the crew exemption moves the crew share toward the record or whether passengers still cannot produce mass during the window.
diagnostics.confined_passenger_bound: confined_passenger_infections_during_window vs the >=52 record-informed bound (NIID Table 2: ~52-92 dated passenger onsets in cabins without a prior confirmed case): at clause theta the shipped tree medians 4-19 — the arm cannot raise it (confinement strength does not create cabin-mate chains), which separates the cabin-channel deficit (D2's leg) from the crew leak this leg measures.

execution.platform: AWS Batch via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_quar_suppression_v1, STRIDE 1, queue picard-analysis-queue (On-Demand; Fargate fallback picard-analysis-fargate-queue), jobdef family picard-covid-boarding-screen. Image is a thin overlay deploy/aws/Dockerfile.covid_quar_suppression FROM picard-campaign:campaign-f31de83a + COPY of this design file.
execution.image_note: The pinned refit-generation image (campaign-e0d43979-*) is NOT reused: the engine tree moved since e0d43979 (FOOD-COMMON-SOURCE-01 merged at 8e8ebc79 — transmission_core +823 — plus the lean census payload at 5eb42b5d). Per the campaign rule the image builds at current main's generation: campaign-f31de83a is the campaign_stack image built for MEGA-IMPACT-01 at merge f31de83a, and the f31de83a..HEAD diff is docs/manifests only — engine-identical to current main. The in-design D0 rows quantify whatever drift that move produced on the covid surface.
execution.canary: Canary = the 1e6/SOP017_ALLHANDS row alone (cells 20-39, INDEX_OFFSET 20, ARRAY_SIZE 20): it proves the scheduled_protocol_id swap resolves (quarantine_witness echoes SOP-017-ALLHANDS, exempt_classes [], activated true) and carries the diagnostic arm's first read. STOP AND REPORT after the canary readout; the remaining 60 cells (the two D0 drift-witness rows and the 7.9e6 ALLHANDS row) run only on the author's go-ahead.
execution.report_immediately_if: the canary's quarantine_witness echo fails on any cell (protocol_id not SOP-017-ALLHANDS, exempt_classes non-empty, activated false — the override never reached the engine); the during-window mass on the canary row collapses fully inside the record-informed band (strong CONFINEMENT-CHANNEL result — report now); the canary row scores < 5 takeoff seeds; any cell's index_onset_day or index_shedding_at_day0 fails the audit invariant; propensity_draw.units_drawn <= 0 on any cell; or the child failure rate exceeds 5%.

rejected_alternatives.other_suppression_protocols: REJECTED: SOP-009/SOP-011/SOP-007 were SUPPRESS-V1's axis and its verdict is settled at the old calibration. D4's question is narrower — is the during-quarantine mass the DECLARED confinement's crew exemption? Only the identical-window identical-modifiers zero-exemption swap isolates that channel; any stronger protocol conflates exemption with channel scalars and venue closures.
rejected_alternatives.retimed_windows: REJECTED: SUPPRESS-V1 measured the window axis (start_day 4-14); D4 holds the record's window fixed so the answer is about the quarantine PHASE, not the calendar.
rejected_alternatives.scoring_the_arm_against_anchors: REJECTED: SOP-017-ALLHANDS is historically false — real DP crew kept working. Scoring a counterfactual against covid.T1/T3/H3 would grade a fiction as if it were the record; the arm's clause fields are reported as context and marked non-scoring.
rejected_alternatives.additional_theta_rows: REJECTED: the suppression read lives at the two clause-leg crossings where mass is already in the serology band; interior rows (1.4e6-5.62e6, both legs failing) add cost without a believability boundary to move.
rejected_alternatives.dropping_the_d0_reruns: REJECTED by the arm grammar (arms[0] must carry empty overrides) and by the drift check: the engine generation moved since the cells of record, so the in-design D0 rows are both the pairing base and the measured-drift witness.
